subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline keys only, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurable behavior would create new user-facing config or CLI surface that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with compatibility-focused tests.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's built-in newline support as enough if docs/help and configurability are intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate from prior issue review plus original and recent TUI/docs history.
